spec2def(msrle32.dll msrle32.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# msrle32.dll is all Rust (msrle32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msrle32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# msrle32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/msrle32-rust/src/msrle32/msrle32.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msrle32_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(msrle32_shims PRIVATE wine libwinmm libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(msrle32_shims)
add_cargo_module(msrle32 msrle32-cargo msrle32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE msrle32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msrle32_shims psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
